name: Crash Pattern Matcher
author: Androbugger Team
description: Matches tombstone backtraces against configurable library patterns and returns known-fix information.

diagnostic_patterns.name: Known Crash Pattern
diagnostic_patterns.description: Tombstone backtrace matches a known-problematic library pattern

patterns.name: Skia rendering crash
patterns.known_fix: Update GPU driver or disable hardware acceleration via adb shell settings put global gpu_debug_layers 0

patterns.name: Media framework crash
patterns.known_fix: Clear media storage: adb shell pm clear com.android.providers.media

patterns.name: OpenGL/EGL crash
patterns.known_fix: Disable hardware overlays: adb shell service call SurfaceFlinger 1008 i32 1

patterns.name: Android runtime crash
patterns.known_fix: Factory reset may be required. Check for OOM conditions before attempting.
